name: vault
description: Keeps an Obsidian vault: one note per session, auto-summarised into Log, Key Decisions and Open Questions on exit, rolled into the daily note, with prior vault context injected into the system prompt

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault folder (the one holding sessions/, daily/, knowledge/ and projects/). Created on first use if missing.

index_script.title: Index script (optional)
index_script.description: Absolute path to a script run after each session as `<script> <repo>` to rebuild a per-repo index. Leave empty to skip.
